[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
import Lean.Data.String

def implementation (string: String) : Nat :=
let characters := string.toList.map fun c => c.toLower
characters.foldl (init := 0) fun count char =>
  if characters.contains char then count else count + 1
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma contains_or_insert_eq_card
(chars: Finset Char)
(char: Char)
: chars.card = (chars.insert char).card ∨
(chars.contains char → chars.card = chars.insert char.card) :=
by
  cases chars with
  | finset.empty => simp
  | finset.some head tail =>
    by_cases h_head_eq_char: head = char
    -- Case 1: head = char
    simp [h_head_eq_char] at h_head_eq_char
    have h_head_eq_char': head = char := h_head_eq_char
    simp [h_head_eq_char']
    split
    -- Case 1.1: head = char and head ∉ chars
    by_cases h_head_not_in_chars: ¬ chars.contains head
    simp [h_head_not_in_chars] at h_head_not_in_chars
    have h_head_not_in_chars': ¬ head ∈ chars := h_head_not_in_chars
    simp [h_head_not_in_chars']
    apply or.inl
    simp [h_head_not_in_chars']
    -- Case 1.2: head = char and head ∈ chars
    simp [h_head_eq_char']
    apply or.inr
    simp [h_head_eq_char']
    apply eq.refl
    -- Case 2: head ≠ char
    simp [h_head_eq_char]
    apply or.inl
    simp [h_head_eq_char]
    simp [h_head_eq_char]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
  unfold problem_spec
  let result := implementation string
  use result
  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]
  let string_idx := {i: Nat | i < string.length}.toFinset
  let characters := string_idx.image (fun i => string.toList.get! i)
  let lowercase_characters := characters.image (fun c => c.toLower)
  have h_result_eq_card := eq.symm (Nat.ofFinsetCard result)
  simp [h_result_eq_card]
  simp [lowercase_characters.card]
  simp [characters]
  simp [string_idx]
  simp [string.toList.get!]
  simp [characters.image]
  simp [lowercase_characters.image]
  simp [lowercase_characters.card]
  have h_distinct_chars := eq.symm (contains_or_insert_eq_card characters.result chars.result)
  simp [h_distinct_chars]
  split
  -- prove result = lowercase_characters.card
  simp [lowercase_characters.card]
  simp [characters]
  simp [string_idx]
  simp [string.toList.get!]
  simp [characters.image]
  simp [lowercase_characters.image]
  simp [lowercase_characters.card]
  simp [result]
  simp [h_result_eq_card]
